compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is part of an account creation process for an application named "Joel." The screen prompts the user to enter their first and last names into two separate text fields. There are navigation buttons labeled "BACK" and "CONTINUE" to move through the account creation steps. The progress indicator at the top shows that this is the first step out of four in the account creation process. The on-screen keyboard is visible at the bottom, indicating that the user is currently inputting text.
